The decision is PENDING_HUMAN: the vendor is on file and the authoritative total of $10,250.00 has clean line math, but the ship-to is Reliable Components Inc. Do not pay until a person confirms why the shipment goes to the vendor and matches a valid purchase order or return authorization.
